python3 << 'PYEOF'
import math
from scipy import stats

data = {
    0.03: [13,14,15,15,15,15,15,15,16,16,17,17],
    0.05: [11,12,13,13,13,13,14,14,15,15,15,15,15,16],
    0.10: [11,13,14,15,15,15,15,16,16,16,17,17,18,18,19,19],
    0.20: [14,15,15,16,16,16,16,17,18,18,20,20],
}

print("=== Per-epsilon Statistics ===\n")
results = {}
for eps, srs in sorted(data.items()):
    n = len(srs)
    mean = sum(srs)/n
    if n > 1:
        var = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in srs) / (n - 1)
        std = math.sqrt(var)
        se = std / math.sqrt(n)
        t_crit = stats.t.ppf(0.975, n-1)
        ci_lo = mean - t_crit * se
        ci_hi = mean + t_crit * se
    else:
        std = 0; se = 0; ci_lo = mean; ci_hi = mean
    
    results[eps] = {'n': n, 'mean': mean, 'std': std, 'se': se, 'ci_lo': ci_lo, 'ci_hi': ci_hi, 'min': min(srs), 'max': max(srs), 'srs': srs}
    print(f"ε={eps:.2f}: n={n}, mean={mean:.2f}%, std={std:.2f}%, CI95=[{ci_lo:.2f}, {ci_hi:.2f}], range=[{min(srs)}, {max(srs)}]")

print("\n=== Pairwise Welch's t-tests ===\n")
eps_list = sorted(data.keys())
for i in range(len(eps_list)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(eps_list)):
        e1, e2 = eps_list[i], eps_list[j]
        r1, r2 = results[e1], results[e2]
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(data[e1], data[e2], equal_var=False)
        sig = "***" if p_val < 0.001 else "**" if p_val < 0.01 else "*" if p_val < 0.05 else "n.s."
        print(f"ε={e1:.2f} vs ε={e2:.2f}: Δ={r2['mean']-r1['mean']:+.2f}pp, t={t_stat:.3f}, p={p_val:.4f} {sig}")

# One-way ANOVA
f_stat, anova_p = stats.f_oneway(*[data[e] for e in eps_list])
print(f"\nOne-way ANOVA: F={f_stat:.3f}, p={anova_p:.6f}")
PYEOF
